chunks: Muhammad b. Ali (may Allah have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: My uncle Muhammad b. Abi'l Qasim narrated to us from Muhammad b. Ali al-Kufi from Muhammad b. Sinan from al-Mufaddal b. Umar from Thabit b. Abi Safiyya from Sa'id b. Jubayr from Abdullah b. Abbas. He said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said:

O people! Who is better than Allah in speech, and more truthful than Allah in words? O people! Surely, your Lord, exalted is His majesty, has commanded me to establish Ali as a sign, an Imam, a caliph, and a deputy for you; and to take him as a brother and a vizier. O people! Ali is the gate of guidance after me and the caller to my Lord. He is the Righteous of the Believers, "And who is better in speech than he who calls to Allah, does righteous works, and says 'Surely, I am from those who submit'" [41:33].

O people! Surely, Ali is from me, his descendants are my descendants, and he is the husband of my beloved. His command is my command, and his prohibition is my prohibition. O people! Betake to obeying him and avoid disobeying him, for obeying him is obeying me, and disobeying him is disobeying me. O people! Surely, Ali is the saint of this nation, its distinguisher, and its inspired one. He is its Harun, its Yusha, its Asif, and its Shamun. He is its Gate of Remission and its Ark of Salvation. He is its Talut and its Dhul Qarnayn. O people! He is the affliction of the creation, the decisive argument, the great sign, the Imam of the people of this world, and the Firm Handle.

O people! Surely, Ali is with the truth, and the truth is with him, and it is upon his tongue. O people! Surely, Ali is the divider of the Fire: a friend of his will not enter the Fire, and an enemy of his will not be saved from it. He is the divider of Paradise: an enemy of his will not enter it, and a friend of his will not slip away from it. O my companions! I have advised you and delivered the message of my Lord to you, but you do not love the advisors. I say this saying of mine, and I seek forgiveness of Allah for myself and for you.

key_terms.الْعُرْوَةُ الْوُثْقَى: The Firm Handle — a Quranic phrase (2:256) applied to Ali as an unbreakable connection to divine guidance
key_terms.بَابُ الْهُدَى: Gate of Guidance — a title given to Imam Ali, indicating he is the primary means of guidance after the Prophet
key_terms.سَفِينَةُ نَجَاتِهَا: Ark of Salvation — comparing Ali and the Ahl al-Bayt to Noah's Ark
key_terms.قَسِيمُ النَّارِ: Divider of the Fire — meaning Ali determines who enters and is saved from Hellfire
key_terms.قَسِيمُ الْجَنَّةِ: Divider of Paradise — meaning Ali determines who enters Paradise

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad say about Imam Ali's station and virtues in his public sermon?
ai.summary: The Prophet Muhammad (s) delivers a public sermon declaring Imam Ali's station and authority. He proclaims that Ali is the gate of guidance, the Righteous of the Believers (citing Quran 41:33), and holds the same relationship to the Prophet as Harun to Musa. Ali is described as the divider of Paradise and Hell, the saint and distinguisher of the nation, and the Firm Handle. The Prophet commands the people to obey Ali and warns that obeying Ali is obeying the Prophet, and disobeying Ali is disobeying the Prophet.

en.bilal-muhammad: Muhammad b. `Ali (rh) narrated to us. He said: My uncle Muhammad b. Abi'l Qasim narrated to us from Muhammad b. `Ali al-Kufi from Muhammad b. Sinan from al-Mufaddal b. `Umar from Thabit b. Abi Safiyya from Sa`id b. Jubayr from `Abdullah b. `Abbas. He said: The Messenger of Allah (s) said:

O people! Who is better than Allah in speech, and more truthful than Allah in words? O people! Surely, my Lord has ordered me to establish `Ali as a sign, an Imam, a caliph, and a deputy for you; and to take him as a brother and a vizier. O people! `Ali is the gate of guidance after me and the caller to my Lord. He is the Righteous of the Believers, "And who is better in speech than he who calls to Allah, does righteous works, and says 'Surely, I am from those who submit.’?" [41:33]?

O people! Surely, `Ali is from me, his descendants are my descendants, and he is the husband of my beloved. His order is my order, and his prohibition is my prohibition. O people! Betake to obeying him, and avoid disobeying him, for obeying him is obeying me, and disobeying him is disobeying me. O people! Surely, `Ali is the saint of this Nation, its distinguisher, and its inspired one. He is its Harun, its Yusha`, its Asif, and its Sham`un. He is its Gate of Remission and its Ark of Salvation. He is its Talut and its Dhul Qarnayn. O people! He is the affliction of the creation, the decisive argument, the great sign, the Imam of the people of this world, and the Firm Handle.

O people! Surely, `Ali is with the truth, and the truth is with `Ali, and `Ali is its tongue. O people! `Ali is the divider of the Fire: a friend of his will not enter the Fire, and an enemy of his will not be saved from it. He is the divider of Paradise: an enemy of his will not enter Paradise, and a friend of his will not slip away from it. O my companions! I have advised you, and I have delivered the message of my Lord to you, but you do not love the advisors. I say this saying of mine, and I repent to Allah for myself and for you.
